notes.title: Patch Notes 1.1.15
notes.notes:
This version includes many improvements and fixes:

- From now, the daily reward will award "Battle" booster packs, which is the next expansion of HumanKind
- Added new explanation for many Character Gifts inside of the card text
- Now you can claim your daily reward just by playing 3 matches or wining just 1
- From now you have to play 3 turns in order to cocede a game
- Many improvements to friend list, and now is faster to challenge friends
- Many other text fixes
